textos.→ Z = {0:.1f} {1:+.1f}j Ω en el objeti: → Z = {0:.1f} {1:+.1f}j Ω at the target, S11 {2:.1f} dB (resonance {3:.1f} MHz)
textos.· ⚠ no cubre la banda del diseño: · ⚠ does not cover the design band
textos.A partir de una medida te dice qué marca: From a measurement it tells you which mark to cut, how many bridges to close or what to fit in the π network. Press «Analyze» on a measurement.
textos.Adapta mal (−5,3 dB) y solo da ~1,8 dBi:: Matches poorly (−5.3 dB) and gives only ~1.8 dBi: the collinear gain is not achieved. Experimental (review the hairpins).
textos.Adaptación ya buena en la frecuencia obj: Match already good at the target frequency: leave Z1 = 0 Ω and Z2/Z3 unfitted.
textos.Adaptador ×{0:.3f}, toma {1:.3f}: Z = {2: Adapter ×{0:.3f}, tap {1:.3f}: Z = {2:.1f} {3:+.1f}j Ω at the target, S11 {4:.1f} dB
textos.Aire entre la cara inferior y el reflect: Air gap between the bottom face and the reflector; tunes the impedance
textos.Ajustado: sigue la forma de la antena (e: Fitted: follows the antenna's shape (envelope with rounded corners)
textos.Ajustar a la frecuencia simulando: Tune to the frequency by simulating
textos.Al ajustar a otra frecuencia, las pistas: When tuning to another frequency, tracks, gaps and other dimensions scale with the wavelength: the design is kept and the simulation is faster
textos.Al elegirla se dimensiona para la banda: Once chosen, it is sized for the band in the bar above. You will only see the basic parameters; the rest are under «Advanced settings». Everything is validated in simulation only.
textos.Alimentación por detrás: SMA hembra de p: Rear feed: panel-mount female SMA in the central hole of the reflector and a straight piece of RG-316 to the board. The braid is soldered to the large pad on the bottom face; the dielectric goes through the hole and the centre conductor is soldered to the small pad on the top face.
textos.Alpha: validado solo en simulación. Mide: Alpha: validated in simulation only. Always measure the manufactured antenna.
textos.Alternativas para la red en π (valores c: Alternatives for the π network (commercial E24 values):
textos.Altura a la que se suelda el coaxial en: Height at which the coax is soldered on the adapter: higher means more impedance.
textos.Altura del radiador. Es la medida que fi: Radiator height. This is the dimension that sets the frequency: taller means lower frequency. «Resize to the frequency» computes it for you.
textos.Ancho de banda ampliado a {0:.1f} % ({1}: Bandwidth widened to {0:.1f} % ({1} = {2} mm), {3:.1f} % needed with margin.
textos.Ancho de la pista. Más ancha: algo más d: Track width. Wider: a little more bandwidth and less loss; factory minimum 0.13 mm.
textos.Ancho de la tira ancha (la «malla»). Deb: Width of the wide strip (the «braid»). It must be much wider than the narrow one: if equal they do not radiate.
textos.Ancho de la tira central (el «boom»), qu: Width of the central strip (the «boom»), which acts as ground and carries the line.
textos.Ancho de la tira de masa del boom [mm]: Width of the boom ground strip [mm]
textos.Ancho de la tira estrecha (el «vivo») [m: Width of the narrow strip (the «live» conductor) [mm]
textos.Ancho de las tiras de la línea que alime: Width of the strips of the line that feeds the dipole.
textos.Ancho de las uniones entre triángulos [m: Width of the joints between triangles [mm]
textos.Ancho de las uniones entre triángulos. E: Width of the joints between triangles. Prevents them touching at just a vertex (doubtful connection when manufacturing and simulating).
textos.Ancho de los brazos. Más ancho: más anch: Arm width. Wider: more bandwidth (and a slightly shorter dipole).
textos.Ancho de los tramos del rodeo λ/2 [mm]: Width of the λ/2 detour sections [mm]
textos.Ancho de pista de dipolo y directores [m: Track width of dipole and directors [mm]
textos.Ancho del marco del borde y de los nervi: Width of the edge frame and of the ribs left between windows.
textos.Ancho del parche. Más ancho: más banda y: Patch width. Wider: more bandwidth and a bit more gain; the frequency barely changes.
textos.Ancho del plano de masa (y de la placa): Width of the ground plane (and of the board) when the ground is manual.
textos.Ancho mínimo de la placa y del reflector: Minimum width of the board and of the reflector.
textos.Anchura del rodeo de media onda que desf: Width of the half-wave detour that shifts the phase of one branch (the balun).
textos.Anchura del zigzag. Más ancho: más corto: Zigzag width. Wider: shorter in height, but takes more board.
textos.Array de 2×2 o 4×4 parches: mucha gananc: Array of 2×2 or 4×4 patches: lots of gain, but not fully validated.
textos.Así quedará el texto:: The text will look like this:
textos.Automática: largo según λ/4 (o fracción): Automatic: length from λ/4 (or a fraction) and width fitted to the radiator
textos.Automática: reflector del ancho del dipo: Automatic: reflector as wide as the dipole and just long enough for the balun
textos.Balun impreso: conector en el borde y un: Printed balun: connector at the edge and a strip acting as the balun (all on the board). Coax at the centre: you solder the coax directly at the centre of the dipole.
textos.Banda estimada {0:g}–{1:g} MHz ({2:g} MH: Estimated band {0:g}–{1:g} MHz ({2:g} MHz, {3:g} %) · needed {4:g}–{5:g} MHz
textos.Banda estrecha en FR4 de 1,6 mm (~36 MHz: Narrow band on 1.6 mm FR4 (~36 MHz at 2.4 GHz): it does not cover the whole 83.5 MHz ISM band. Efficiency ~47 % because of the FR4 losses.
textos.Banda muy ancha: durante el ajuste el ce: Very wide band: while tuning, the band centre may jump between two resonances.
textos.Boom corto: el balun funciona mejor con: Short boom: the balun works better with a ground strip of ~λg/4 under the line.
textos.Bowtie, bowtie de Sierpinski y panel de: Bowtie, Sierpinski bowtie and single-element panel: new types, still to be validated in simulation (the initial size comes from an uncalibrated estimate). Simulate and tune it before manufacturing.
textos.Bowtie: brazos triangulares, más ancho d: Bowtie: triangular arms, more bandwidth. Not simulated yet
textos.Bowtie: más ancho de banda (tolera mejor: Bowtie: more bandwidth (tolerates εr and solder-mask deviations better). Not simulated yet
textos.Cada director mide (1 − este valor) vece: Each director is (1 − this value) times the previous one
Each director is (1 − this value) times the previous one.
textos.Cada iteración de Koch reduce la altura,: Each Koch iteration reduces the height, but also the bandwidth and the efficiency; beyond iteration 3 there is hardly any gain.
textos.Cada rama mide λ/4 en tiras paralelas; e: Each branch is λ/4 in parallel strips; this lengthens or shortens it
textos.Calibra al final del latiguillo que vaya: Calibrate at the end of the patch cable you will use with the antenna: the measurement plane ends up there.
textos.Cierra {0} puente(s) de tramo, empezando: Close {0} section bridge(s), starting with the one nearest the radiator (lowers ≈ {1:.1f} %).
textos.Coaxial soldado al centro (una cara): Coax soldered at the centre (one side)
textos.Coaxial: vivo al brazo derecho, malla al: Coax: live conductor to the right arm, braid to the left; with a ferrite on the cable
textos.Colineal Franklin con horquillas: adapta: Franklin collinear with hairpins: still matches poorly.
textos.Colineal coaxial impresa: radia, pero la: Printed coaxial collinear: it radiates, but the FR4 losses eat the gain.
textos.Coloca la antena en un borde o esquina d: Put the antenna at an edge or corner of the board, with the radiator pointing outwards, and far (≥ λ/10) from batteries, screens or metal parts.
textos.Con IPEX el monopolo recto adaptó mal en: With IPEX the straight monopole matched poorly in simulation (−7 dB): the central pad transition is under review. It works well with SMA.
textos.Con alimentación directa, la Yagi solo a: With direct feed, the Yagi only matches if the reflector is moved away (~0.39 λ0), which lengthens the board. The tested version: straight elements, 2 directors, 7.2 dBi.
textos.Con balun impreso: el boom (la tira de m: With printed balun: the boom (the ground strip under the line) is part of the balun; do not trim it or put copper at its sides.
textos.Con coaxial al centro: vivo al brazo der: With coax at the centre: live conductor to the right arm and braid to the left, and take the cable out perpendicular to the arms for at least λ/4 before bending it; a ferrite next to the solder joint stops the braid radiating.
textos.Con dipolo plegado ha salido radiando ha: With a folded dipole it has radiated backwards (F/B −3.6 dB) and with less gain (5.6 dBi). Use direct feed.
textos.Con elementos de Koch la Yagi ha salido: With Koch elements the Yagi has gone wrong in simulation (matches poorly and radiates more backwards than towards the directors). Use straight elements (iteration 0).
textos.Con los directores unidos al boom la fre: With the directors joined to the boom the frequency jumps between modes while tuning and the match is slightly worse than with separate directors.
textos.Con masa compacta el cable forma parte d: With a compact ground the cable becomes part of the antenna: measure with a ferrite on the coax 2–3 cm from the board and without touching the board.
textos.Con muchos tramos, la corriente decae ha: With many sections the current decays towards the tip and the gain barely grows.
textos.Con parásitos cerca, el dipolo baja a ~1: With parasitic elements nearby, the dipole drops to ~10–15 Ω: the transformer or the folding takes it to 50 Ω
textos.Con sobrelargo del {0:g} %: se ajusta pa: With an extra length of {0:g} %: it is tuned so that, uncut, it resonates at {1:.1f} MHz (cutting at the marks reaches {2:.1f} MHz).
textos.Con transformador λ/4: radia hacia delan: With λ/4 transformer: radiates forwards, but narrow band (~50 MHz) and efficiency ~55 %.
textos.Con {0} directores la Yagi gana poco por: With {0} directors the Yagi gains little per extra director (~0.5–1 dB) and the board grows a lot.
textos.Concentran la señal hacia un lado: para: They concentrate the signal to one side: for linking two distant points or a repeater pointing down a valley.
textos.Conecta la antena. Cada medida se guarda: Connect the antenna. Each measurement is saved in the design with its label; live mode repeats the measurement near the band while you cut or change the π network, without saving it.
textos.Conéctalo por USB. Solo se lee su estado: Connect it by USB. Only its status is read: its calibration and saved slots are not touched.
textos.Corrige el largo de las horquillas de de: Corrects the length of the phase-shift hairpins (1 = calculated λ/4).
textos.Corrige el largo del adaptador λ/4 calcu: Corrects the calculated λ/4 adapter length (1 = no correction).
textos.Corta por la marca «{0}» (con tu medida: Cut at the mark «{0}» (with your measurement it will end up ≈ {1:.0f} MHz).
textos.Cubre la banda pero con poco margen: las: It covers the band but with little margin: manufacturing tolerances (εr ±2–3 %) can take you out of it. Leave margin or plan for the π network.
textos.Cumple las reglas «{0}» (pista ≥ {1} mm,: Meets the «{0}» rules (track ≥ {1} mm, gap ≥ {2} mm)
textos.Curva de Hilbert: muy compacta, pero ada: Hilbert curve: very compact, but matches poorly without a π network.
textos.Curva de Hilbert: muy compacta; el orden: Hilbert curve: very compact; a high order demands fine tracks and gaps.
textos.Curva de Koch: la iteración alarga la pi: Koch curve: the iteration lengthens the track without increasing the height.
textos.Cuánto baja la frecuencia cada tramo (el: How much each section lowers the frequency (the program enlarges it if the section does not physically fit).
textos.Cuánto sobresale el reflector de la plac: How far the reflector protrudes beyond the board on each side. Larger: less backward radiation.
textos.Cómo llega la señal al radiador. Cada ti: How the signal reaches the radiator. Each type has its own options; check the known problems of each one.
textos.Cómo se calcula el plano de masa (la «ot: How the ground plane (the «other half» of a monopole) is computed. «λ/4» is the recommended one; the compact ones shrink the board but make the antenna more sensitive to whatever is connected behind it.
textos.Cómo se cierra cada tramo: con una gota: How each section is closed: with a drop of solder or with a 0 Ω resistor.
textos.Debe ser bastante más ancha que la estre: It must be much wider than the narrow one: if both are equal it does not radiate
textos.Deja sin cobre, en las dos caras, toda l: Leaves the whole radiator area free of copper on both faces (the footprint's box). No tracks, fills or vias underneath.
textos.Deja sitio a los taladros M3 de las esqu: Leaves room for the M3 holes in the corners
textos.Del conector al reflector [mm]: From the connector to the reflector [mm]
3D pattern with the board · maximum θ {0:.0f}°, φ {1:.0f}°
textos.Diagrama omnidireccional en el plano per: Omnidirectional pattern in the plane perpendicular to the arms, with ~2 dBi; for Meshtastic, mount the arms vertically.
Omnidirectional pattern in the plane perpendicular to the radiator, with ~2 dBi; mount it vertically.
textos.Dipolo (Koch o recto) alimentado por bal: Dipole (Koch or straight) fed by a microstrip→CPS balun; the ground acts as a reflector and 0–8 directors, each a bit shorter than the previous one. Gain ~4–11 dBi.
textos.Dipolo de Koch sin validar en simulación: Koch dipole not validated in simulation yet (the straight one is).
textos.Dipolo de media onda, omnidireccional en: Half-wave dipole, omnidirectional in the plane perpendicular to the arms (~2 dBi). With SMA and printed balun (one arm on each face) or with coax soldered at the centre.
textos.Dipolo impreso (recto, de Koch o bowtie): Printed dipole (straight, Koch or bowtie) with balun: needs no ground, symmetrical radiation.
textos.Dipolos impresos (un brazo en cada cara): Printed dipoles (one arm on each face) with an H network of parallel strips, over a reflector separated by air (second board or metal sheet). Rear coax, at the centre. Beam towards the side opposite the reflector; 2×2 ≈ 12–13 dBi and 4×4 ≈ 16–17 dBi, minus the network losses.
textos.Dipolos o bowtie sobre un reflector (seg: Dipoles or bowtie over a reflector (second board): 1 element or 2×2 / 4×4, up to 17 dBi for long links.
textos.Directa: el dipolo va tal cual; adapta a: Direct: the dipole is used as is; it matches by moving the reflector away (longer board), and it is the validated one. λ/4 transformer: matches with the reflector close, but with narrow band. Folded dipole: in simulation it radiated backwards.
textos.Directores muy juntos para tantos elemen: Directors very close together for so many elements: typical spacing 0.15–0.3 λ0.
textos.Disposición de los dipolos. «Todos igual: Dipole layout. «All equal» matches better; the symmetric one does not correct the beam tilt.
textos.Disposición simétrica: tras el cruce de: Symmetric layout: after the via crossing, the bottom-face copper of the left half goes to the live conductor, not to ground. The braid is soldered only to the central pad; do not connect any other board copper to the reflector or to the coax.
textos.Distancia de la T al borde de masa [mm]: Distance from the T to the ground edge [mm]
textos.Distancia de las ventanas al cobre [mm]: Distance from the windows to the copper [mm]
textos.Distancia del reflector al dipolo. En la: Distance from the reflector to the dipole. On the Yagi, the usual value is 0.15–0.25 λ0; on the panel, 0.25 λ0 (a quarter wave) gives the maximum gain.
textos.Distancia entre dipolos, en longitudes d: Distance between dipoles, in wavelengths. ~0.75 λ0 gives the maximum gain.
textos.Distancia entre ejes del conductor parti: Distance between the axes of the split conductor and the whole one
textos.Distancia entre el dipolo y los director: Distance between the dipole and the directors, and between directors.
textos.Distancia entre el divisor de la aliment: Distance between the feed splitter and the edge of the ground.
textos.Distancia entre la curva y el borde del: Distance between the curve and the edge of the ground plane.
textos.Distancia entre la red de alimentación y: Distance between the feed network and the patches.
textos.Distancia entre los dos conductores del: Distance between the two conductors of the folded dipole.
textos.Distancia entre parches, en longitudes d: Distance between patches, in wavelengths. ~0.7–0.8 λ0 gives the maximum gain without large side lobes.
textos.Distancia mínima del cobre al borde de l: Minimum distance from the copper to the board edge (the manufacturer does not allow copper right at the edge).
textos.Distancia mínima entre las ventanas y el: Minimum distance between the windows and the copper.
textos.Eficiencia baja en FR4 (~33 % en la iter: Low efficiency on FR4 (~33 % at iteration 1) and narrow band (~41 MHz).
textos.Eficiencia de radiación del {0:.0f} %: c: Radiation efficiency of {0:.0f} %: it hardly radiates at {1:.0f} MHz. Probably a false resonance (disconnected piece in the model or a line resonance); check the geometry.
textos.El Hilbert es muy compacto pero sensible: The Hilbert curve is very compact but sensitive to manufacturing: keep the gap between turns ≥ 2 times the track width.
textos.El IPEX ocupa {0:.1f} mm desde el borde: The IPEX takes {0:.1f} mm from the edge and covers copper that is not the 50 Ω line: lengthen the feed line.
textos.El adaptador λ/4 se calcula solo; esto l: The λ/4 adapter is computed automatically; this lengthens or shortens it
textos.El ancho de banda estimado ({0:g} MHz) n: The estimated bandwidth ({0:g} MHz) does not cover the {1:g} MHz band: press «Widen bandwidth» or change the type.
textos.El dipolo plegado se hace siempre recto:: The folded dipole is always straight: the Koch iteration only affects the parasitic elements.
textos.El diseño no estaba guardado (o cambió d: The design was not saved (or changed during the simulation): the result stays only in salidas/_simulaciones.
textos.El haz sale por el lado de los dipolos (: The beam leaves on the side of the dipoles (away from the reflector), with polarization parallel to the arms: for Meshtastic, mount the panel with the arms vertical.
textos.El hueco más estrecho ({0:.2f} mm) queda: The narrowest gap ({0:.2f} mm) has fewer than 2 cells: the result may come out short-circuited; use «fine» precision.
textos.El panel admite un solo elemento, 2×2 o: The panel accepts a single element, 2×2 or 4×4
textos.El plano de masa debajo del parche debe: The ground plane under the patch must be continuous; extend at least 6 times the substrate thickness on each side.
textos.El plano de masa hace de reflector: debe: The ground plane acts as a reflector: it must be electrically longer than the dipole (≈ λ0/2 wide or more); if narrower it acts as a director and the beam goes backwards.
The port does not fall on the mesh ({0} = {1:.4f} mm): openEMS would discard it and the simulation would run without excitation
textos.El reflector debe ser un 5–10 % más larg: The reflector must be 5–10 % longer than the dipole and 0.15–0.25 λ0 away; moving it closer lowers the impedance and the efficiency.
textos.Elementos λ/2 sobre la base λ/4: λ/2 elements on the λ/4 base
textos.Elige o haz antes una calibración: Choose or make a calibration first
textos.Elige un diseño de la lista: Choose a design from the list
textos.En el meandro, los tramos horizontales s: On the meander, the horizontal sections partly cancel: the more turns, the more compact but the less efficient.
textos.En simulación el haz sale ~9° inclinado: In simulation the beam comes out ~9° tilted (3° on the 4×4); it looks like a simulation artifact, unconfirmed. The tuning does not iterate the frequency.
textos.Este diseño aún no tiene simulación ni m: This design has no simulation or measurements yet.
textos.Este tipo solo se ha validado en simulac: This type has only been validated in simulation at 2.4 GHz: at other frequencies the estimate may be less accurate. Simulate it.
textos.Ferrita (o choke de λ/4) en el cable jun: Ferrite (or λ/4 choke) on the cable next to the connector: without it, the braid radiates and shifts the resonance and the pattern.
textos.Forma de cada elemento: dipolo recto, bo: Shape of each element: straight dipole, bowtie (triangles) or Sierpinski bowtie. The bowtie tolerates frequency deviations better (more bandwidth).
textos.Forma de cada parche: rectangular o frac: Shape of each patch: rectangular or Minkowski fractal.
textos.Forma de la placa: rectangular o ajustad: Board shape: rectangular or fitted to the antenna (rounded corners, less FR4).
textos.Forma de los brazos: pista recta o de Ko: Arm shape: straight or Koch track (with the Koch iteration), bowtie (two triangles) or Sierpinski bowtie. The bowtie tolerates frequency deviations better.
textos.Guarda el diseño (o haz una medida) para: Save the design (or make a measurement) to see its measurements and its simulation here.
textos.Guarda el diseño y exporta la placa de p: Saves the design and exports the KiCad test board, the footprint, the Gerbers for JLC (with drills) and the DXF to the design's «fabricacion» folder. It passes the KiCad DRC.
textos.Hilbert de orden 4 o más: hueco entre vu: Hilbert of order 4 or more: gap between turns is very small; check the manufacturing checks and JLC's tolerance.
textos.Hueco a cada lado de la línea en la ranu: Gap on each side of the line in the slot [mm]
textos.Hueco en cada cruce entre tramos (las ti: Gap at each crossing between sections (the strips cross with two vias).
textos.Hueco entre la línea y el parche a cada: Gap between the line and the patch on each side of the slot.
textos.Hueco entre las dos ramas de cada horqui: Gap between the two branches of each hairpin.
textos.Hueco entre las dos tiras de la línea qu: Gap between the two strips of the line that feeds the dipole.
textos.Hueco entre los brazos en el centro, don: Gap between the arms at the centre, where the coax is soldered (coax feed).
textos.Hueco entre los dos brazos del adaptador: Gap between the two arms of the λ/4 adapter.
textos.IPEX / U.FL (MHF1, no MHF4): aguanta ~30: IPEX / U.FL (MHF1, not MHF4): withstands ~30 mating cycles. The 1.13 mm pigtail loses ~0.5 dB per 10 cm at 2.4 GHz (~0.3 dB at 868 MHz): keep it as short as possible.
textos.IPEX: encima de la placa a 3 mm del bord: IPEX: on top of the board 3 mm from the edge; the minimum monopole ground drops from 12 to 7 mm and the minimum width from 16 to 8 mm
textos.Impedancia del tramo λ/4 que adapta el d: Impedance of the λ/4 section that matches the dipole to 50 Ω.
textos.Inserción acortada para no partir el par: Feed insertion shortened so as not to split the patch (narrow central neck): the match will be worse; use a lower Minkowski iteration or depth.
textos.Iteración 3 o más: los detalles son pequ: Iteration 3 or more: the details are tiny and the size gain marginal; iteration 2 is usually the best compromise.
textos.Iteración de Koch de los elementos (0 =: Koch iteration of the elements (0 = straight)
textos.Iteración del fractal de Minkowski de ca: Minkowski fractal iteration of each patch (if the element is Minkowski).
textos.Iteración {0}: impedancia de borde muy b: Iteration {0}: very low edge impedance (~14 Ω), S11 ≈ −5 dB and efficiency ~23 % in simulation (the slot does not fix it); the size estimate is off by 10–40 %. Use iteration 1.
textos.J-pole con el radiador en curva de Koch:: J-pole with the radiator as a Koch curve: shorter for the same frequency.
textos.J-pole con radiador de Koch: sin masa, s: J-pole with Koch radiator: no ground, fed with coax. For a mast.
textos.J-pole recta: adapta mal; usa la J-pole: Straight J-pole: matches poorly; use the Koch J-pole.
textos.La J-pole no lleva plano de masa: suelda: The J-pole has no ground plane: solder the coax to the tap pads (live conductor to the long arm, braid to the short one) and take it downwards, along the axis of the adapter.
textos.La J-pole recta resuena donde toca pero: The straight J-pole resonates where it should but matches poorly (R ≈ 6–10 Ω): moving the tap does not fix it. Model under review; use the Koch J-pole.
textos.La alimentación va por un extremo: los t: The feed is at one end: the far sections receive less current, so going beyond 4–5 sections hardly gains anything.
textos.La altura de la toma ajusta la impedanci: The tap height adjusts the impedance: raise it if the S11 lies in the low-impedance region of the Smith chart and lower it if it lies in the high-impedance one.
textos.La antena sale este % más larga (frecuen: The antenna comes out this % longer (lower frequency) and the silkscreen marks where to cut to raise it.
textos.La antena sale este % por debajo y las m: The antenna comes out this % lower and the marks show where to cut
textos.La banda va de {0:g} a {1:g} MHz: centra: The band goes from {0:g} to {1:g} MHz: centre the antenna at {2:g} MHz, not at {3:g} MHz.
textos.La cara superior tiene {0} piezas de cob: The top face has {0} separate pieces of copper
textos.La disposición simétrica con cruce no co: The symmetric layout with crossing does not correct the beam tilt and worsens the match (−10 dB versus −15.7 dB for the normal one). «All equal» is better.
textos.La frecuencia salta varios % con pequeño: The frequency jumps several % with small changes in height (mesh noise with the meander): the tuning may need more iterations. With a small ground it may not reach −10 dB.
textos.La línea de la simulación aparece cuando: The simulation line appears when the design is saved, unchanged and simulated.
textos.La rama es demasiado corta para el cruce: The branch is too short for the strip crossing: increase the spacing.
textos.La ranura ahorra la cola del transformad: The slot saves the transformer tail (~λg/4 under the patch)
textos.La red pierde ~{0:.1f} dB: con este sust: The network loses ~{0:.1f} dB: with this substrate the large array compensates little compared with a smaller one.
textos.La resonancia está un {0:+.1f} % desviad: The resonance is {0:+.1f} % off and this antenna has no cut/section margin: correct it with the π network or redesign.
textos.La resonancia ya está en la frecuencia o: The resonance is already at the target frequency.
textos.La separación placa–reflector ajusta la: The board–reflector spacing tunes the impedance: measure and, if needed, change the length of the spacers (±2–3 mm) before touching anything else.
textos.La simulación NO cubre la banda entera: The simulation does NOT cover the whole band
textos.La simulación terminó sin resultado (mir: The simulation ended without a result (see the console).
textos.La toma suele estar entre el 10 y el 40: The tap is usually between 10 and 40 % of the adapter for 50 Ω.
textos.La εr del FR4 de JLC está pendiente de m: The εr of JLC's FR4 is still to be measured with the coupon: the real frequency can move ±2–3 %.
textos.Lado del cuadrado que ocupa la curva. Fi: Side of the square occupied by the curve. It sets the frequency: larger means lower. «Resize» computes it.
textos.Largo de cada brazo del dipolo (entre ex: Length of each dipole arm (between ends) [mm]
textos.Largo de cada brazo del dipolo. Fija la: Length of each dipole arm. It sets the frequency: longer means lower. «Resize» computes it.
textos.Largo de cada elemento de media onda: fi: Length of each half-wave element: it sets the frequency. «Resize» computes it.
textos.Largo de cada parche: fija la frecuencia: Length of each patch: it sets the frequency. «Resize» computes it.
textos.Largo de cada tramo de media onda: fija: Length of each half-wave section: it sets the frequency. «Resize» computes it.
textos.Largo de la CPS sobre la masa [mm]: Length of the CPS over the ground [mm]
textos.Largo de la línea de 50 Ω desde el conec: Length of the 50 Ω line from the connector to the antenna.
textos.Largo de la línea de dos tiras: también: Length of the two-strip line: it also adjusts the match.
textos.Largo del 1.er director (fracción del di: Length of the 1st director (fraction of the dipole)
textos.Largo del balun impreso (la tira central: Length of the printed balun (the central strip): separates the antenna from the connector.
textos.Largo del plano de masa cuando es manual: Ground plane length when manual. Below λ/4 the frequency rises and the radiator must be lengthened.
textos.Largo del primer director respecto al di: Length of the first director relative to the dipole. Shorter than the dipole so that it directs forwards.
textos.Largo del radiador: fija la frecuencia (: Radiator length: it sets the frequency (longer means lower). «Resize» computes it.
Reflector length relative to the dipole. Longer than the dipole so that it reflects forwards.
textos.Largo resonante del parche: fija la frec: Resonant length of the patch: it sets the frequency (longer means lower). «Resize» computes it.
textos.Las bowtie casi se tocan en vertical: su: The bowties almost touch vertically: increase the spacing or close the aperture.
textos.Las muescas de Minkowski reducen el parc: The Minkowski notches shrink the patch by 10–25 % at the cost of bandwidth; the notch depth is the parameter with the most influence.
textos.Las pérdidas de la red crecen con el tam: Network losses grow with size: on FR4, a 4×4 at 2.4 GHz loses ~3.5 dB. For large arrays or at 5.8 GHz, consider RO4350B.
textos.Las ramas de la red son más cortas que e: The network branches are shorter than the 70.7 Ω λ/4: increase the spacing.
textos.Las vueltas de la pista se pisan ({0:.0f: The turns of the track overlap ({0:.0f} % of the area): the curve is too dense for that width; lower the iteration/order, narrow the track or enlarge the antenna
textos.Licencia CC BY-NC 4.0 (diseños que vayas: CC BY-NC 4.0 licence (designs you will publish)
textos.Lo aparta a la subcarpeta _archivados (n: Moves it to the _archivados subfolder (nothing is deleted)
textos.Lo habitual es 0,15–0,25 λ0; en λ0 para: The usual value is 0.15–0.25 λ0; in λ0 so that it does not shrink with Koch elements
textos.Los dipolos casi se tocan en la direcció: The dipoles almost touch in the direction of their arms: increase the spacing.
textos.Los directores apuntan hacia donde quier: The directors point where you want the gain. More directors: more gain and a narrower beam, but a longer board and slightly less bandwidth.
textos.Los recortes de aligerado no se han simu: The lightening cut-outs have not been simulated yet: removing FR4 raises the frequency a little. Simulate it before manufacturing.
textos.Malla muy grande ({0:.0f} M celdas): la: Very large mesh ({0:.0f} M cells): the simulation will take a long time.
textos.Malla {0}×{1}×{2} = {3:.2f} M celdas (pa: Mesh {0}×{1}×{2} = {3:.2f} M cells (step on the board {4:.2f} mm; min. track {5:.2f} mm, min. gap {6:.2f} mm)
textos.Marcas de corte rotuladas con la simulac: Cut marks labelled with the simulation (×{0:.4f} over the estimate)
textos.Marco del borde, nervio central y nervio: Edge frame, central rib and ribs that split the long windows
textos.Margen de la placa alrededor del cobre (: Board margin around the copper (leaves room for the corner holes).
textos.Masa de {0:.0f} mm, el {1:.0f} % de λ/4:: Ground of {0:.0f} mm, {1:.0f} % of λ/4: less efficiency and bandwidth, and the cable becomes part of the antenna (use a ferrite when measuring).
textos.Masa de {0:.0f} mm, menos de λ/4: el cab: Ground of {0:.0f} mm, less than λ/4: the cable becomes part of the antenna (ferrite when measuring).
textos.Medidas secundarias pasadas a «Manuales»: Secondary dimensions switched to «Manual» to respect the value you entered.
textos.Menos peso y algo menos de pérdidas; qui: Less weight and slightly less loss; removing FR4 raises the frequency a little: simulate again
textos.Microstrip por el boom; medio dipolo en: Microstrip along the boom; half a dipole on each face (the line acts as the balun), reflector on the bottom face joined to ground and 0–8 directors, separate or joined to the boom. Straight or Koch elements. Narrow, long board; gain ~4.5–11 dBi.
textos.Mide con la antena apuntando a un espaci: Measure with the antenna pointing at an open space: an object in front, closer than ~1 m, changes the match.
textos.Mide con la antena vertical y lejos de m: Measure with the antenna vertical and away from tables or metal walls: it is long and anything nearby affects it.
textos.Minkowski de iteración 3 en el array: lo: Minkowski iteration 3 in the array: the necks may fall below the manufacturing rules.
textos.Monopolo fractal de Koch: más compacto q: Koch fractal monopole: more compact than the straight one, with good bandwidth. Recommended.
textos.Monopolo λ/4 sobre masa seguido de eleme: λ/4 monopole over ground followed by λ/2 elements joined by λ/4 hairpins that invert the phase. One face; omnidirectional, ~4–6 dBi. The hairpins widen the board.
textos.Multibanda con bandas a razón ~2 (la ape: Multiband with bands in a ratio of ~2 (the triangle aperture shifts them). 868 MHz and 2.4 GHz are in a ratio of 2.8: they do not fit the classic Sierpinski.
textos.Más ancho: más ancho de banda (y dipolo: Wider: more bandwidth (and a slightly shorter dipole)
textos.Más grosor de sustrato da más ancho de b: A thicker substrate gives more bandwidth and efficiency; on 1.6 mm FR4 a patch at 2.4 GHz has about 2–3 % bandwidth and 50–70 % efficiency.
textos.Nivel del Sierpinski de cada brazo (solo: Sierpinski level of each arm (only with «Sierpinski bowtie»). More iterations: more gaps and an electrically longer arm.
Sierpinski level of each arm (only with «Sierpinski bowtie»). More iterations: more gaps, an electrically longer arm and slightly less bandwidth.
textos.Nivel del fractal. Más iteración: antena: Fractal level. More iterations: more compact antenna, but less bandwidth and slightly less efficiency. 0 = no fractal (straight). Usually 1–2.
textos.No caben en la serigrafía:: They do not fit in the silkscreen:
textos.No dependen de la placa a la que se cone: They do not depend on the board they are connected to: good for a mast or away from the equipment.
textos.No funciona sin red en π: Does not work without a π network
textos.No funciona: adapta mal (usa la de Koch): Does not work: matches poorly (use the Koch one)
textos.No hay calibraciones guardadas: calibra: There are no saved calibrations: calibrate now.
textos.No llega a −10 dB cerca del objetivo (mí: It does not reach −10 dB near the target (minimum {0:.1f} dB): poor match; resonance by {1}.
textos.No llega: {0:.1f} % estimado frente a {1: It does not get there: {0:.1f} % estimated versus {1:.1f} % needed (with margin). To gain bandwidth: {2}.
textos.No pongas cobre fuera del plano de masa: Do not put copper outside the ground plane (dipole and director area) on either face.
textos.No se alcanza {0:.0f} MHz dentro de los: {0:.0f} MHz cannot be reached within the limits of "{1}" (it ends at {2:.0f} MHz): change other parameters.
textos.Número de directores (elementos delante: Number of directors (elements in front of the dipole). More directors: more gain and a narrower beam, but a longer board.
textos.Número de elementos de media onda sobre: Number of half-wave elements on the base. More elements: more gain and a longer antenna.
textos.Número de elementos: 1 = uno solo sobre: Number of elements: 1 = a single one over the reflector (no network, ~7–9 dBi), 2 = 2×2 (4 elements) and 4 = 4×4 (16, ~4–5 dB more and a board 4 times larger).
textos.Número de elementos: 2 = 2×2 (4 elemento: Number of elements: 2 = 2×2 (4 elements), 4 = 4×4 (16 elements, ~4–5 dB more and a board 4 times larger).
textos.Número de idas y vueltas del zigzag. Más: Number of back-and-forth runs of the zigzag. More turns: lower antenna, but less bandwidth.
textos.Número de tramos. Más tramos: más gananc: Number of sections. More sections: more gain in theory and a longer antenna.
textos.Omnidireccional con el haz aplastado hac: Omnidirectional with the beam squashed towards the horizon: more sections or elements, more gain but a narrower vertical beam and a narrower band. Mount it vertically.
textos.Orden de la curva de Hilbert: cada orden: Hilbert curve order: each extra order folds the track more and shrinks the antenna, at the cost of a worse match and slower simulations.
textos.Para medir con el NanoVNA hace falta un: To measure with the NanoVNA you need an IPEX–SMA pigtail: measure it first with vna/medir_latiguillo.py and subtract its delay, or the apparent frequency shifts.
textos.Para medir la ganancia relativa, compara: To measure relative gain, compare with a straight reference monopole at the same distance.
textos.Para probar y aprender: tienen problemas: To try out and learn: they have known problems.
textos.Parche alargado {0:.1f} %: corta en para: Patch lengthened by {0:.1f} %: cut parallel to the top edge at the mark for the desired frequency.
textos.Parche cuadrado con bordes de Minkowski:: Square patch with Minkowski edges: smaller than the rectangular one.
textos.Parche fractal de Minkowski: más pequeño: Minkowski fractal patch: smaller than the rectangular one, but it loses more.
Microstrip patch with λ/4 transformer. Directional (~6 dBi).
textos.Parche sobre plano de masa: algo directi: Patch over a ground plane: somewhat directional (~5 dBi) and narrow band.
textos.Parches rectangulares o de Minkowski con: Rectangular or Minkowski patches with an in-phase corporate network. 2×2 ≈ 10–11 dBi and 4×4 ≈ 15–17 dBi ideal, minus the network losses (estimated).
textos.Parámetros ajustados aplicados. Guarda e: Tuned parameters applied. Save the design to keep them.
textos.Pasa el dieléctrico; 1,7 mm para RG-316: The dielectric passes through; 1.7 mm for RG-316 / RG-174
textos.Pasillo entre filas de {0:.1f} mm: muy j: Gap between rows of {0:.1f} mm: very tight for the phase U; increase the spacing between patches.
textos.Pedido, fecha de fabricación, qué se cor: Order, manufacturing date, what was cut, results…
textos.Plano de masa que sobresale alrededor de: Ground plane that protrudes around the patch. Below ~λ/20 the backward radiation increases.
textos.Plano de masa, que hace de reflector det: Ground plane, which acts as a reflector behind the dipole.
textos.Pon la CARGA de 50 Ω al final del latigu: Fit the 50 Ω LOAD at the end of the patch cable. When well calibrated, |S11| is below −30 dB.
textos.Pon una ferrita (o unas vueltas del coax: Fit a ferrite (or a few turns of the coax) just under the tap: without a choke, the braid radiates and shifts the resonance.
textos.Por el borde, con transformador λ/4: From the edge, with λ/4 transformer
textos.Por el borde: la línea llega al borde de: From the edge: the line reaches the patch edge with a λ/4 transformer (longer). Slot: the line enters the patch up to the 50 Ω point (more compact).
textos.Por encima de ~3 GHz el FR4 pierde basta: Above ~3 GHz the FR4 loses a lot and its εr varies between batches: consider RO4350B.
textos.Por ranura (inset) hasta el punto de 50: By slot (inset) up to the 50 Ω point
textos.Prevé una red en π (huellas 0402/0603: s: Plan a π network (0402/0603 footprints: series + two to ground) next to the feed to tune the match once manufactured.
textos.Profundidad de la ranura de alimentación: Depth of the feed slot inside the patch. 0 = the program computes it for 50 Ω.
textos.Profundidad de la ranura desde el borde: Slot depth from the patch edge [mm] (0 = estimated)
textos.Profundidad de las muescas del fractal d: Depth of the Minkowski fractal notches (fraction of a third of the side). Deeper: smaller patch for the same frequency.
textos.Punto donde se suelda el coaxial; más ar: Point where the coax is soldered; higher = more impedance
textos.Quasi-Yagi con dipolo de Koch: radia hac: Quasi-Yagi with Koch dipole: radiates backwards in simulation.
textos.Radia (D 4,7 dBi) pero las pérdidas del: It radiates (D 4.7 dBi) but the FR4 losses leave the efficiency at ~53 % and the gain at ~1.9 dBi: the collinear gain is not noticeable.
textos.Radia hacia atrás (hacia el reflector) y: Radiates backwards (towards the reflector) and matches poorly (−3.5 dB) in simulation. Experimental: do not manufacture it yet.
textos.Radia hacia el lado del parche: no lo ta: Radiates towards the patch side: do not cover it with metal or stick it to the case.
textos.Radiador λ/2 con adaptador λ/4 de tiras: λ/2 radiator with parallel-strip λ/4 adapter; no ground plane. Fed with coax soldered at the tap point.
textos.Radian en todas direcciones: para nodos: They radiate in all directions: for Meshtastic nodes, trackers and equipment that moves. Compact.
textos.Rayas en la serigrafía con la frecuencia: Lines on the silkscreen with the frequency, in MHz, left after cutting at each one.
textos.Recortes: no cabe ninguna ventana con es: Cut-outs: no window fits with that margin and that rib.
textos.Red en π ({0}): Z1 en serie = 0 Ω de fáb: π network ({0}): series Z1 = 0 Ω from the factory; Z2 (connector side) and Z3 (antenna side) to ground, not fitted. Use the assistant with your measurement to choose values.
textos.Red en π en la línea de 50 Ω: π network on the 50 Ω line
textos.Red en π: Z1 (serie) = {0}, {1} (a masa): π network: Z1 (series) = {0}, {1} (to ground) = {2}, the other shunt not fitted (calculated |S11| {3} dB with commercial values).
textos.Reflector a {0:.2f} λ0 del dipolo: lo ha: Reflector at {0:.2f} λ0 from the dipole: the usual value is 0.15–0.25 λ0 (closer lowers the impedance and the efficiency).
textos.Reflector a {0:.2f} λ0: lo habitual es 0: Reflector at {0:.2f} λ0: the usual value is 0.2–0.25 λ0 (closer lowers the impedance and the band; farther distorts the beam).
textos.Reflector de más de 400 mm: mejor una ch: Reflector over 400 mm: better an aluminium sheet than a PCB.
textos.Reflector más corto que el dipolo: actua: Reflector shorter than the dipole: it will act as a director and the beam will go backwards.
textos.Reflector más grande que la placa, por l: Reflector larger than the board, per side [λ0]
textos.Respecto a «{0}»: resonancia {1:g} → {2:: Compared with «{0}»: resonance {1:g} → {2:g} MHz ({3:+.1f} MHz); at the target {4:g} → {5:g} dB
textos.Resuena en el objetivo pero con S11 {0}: It resonates at the target but with S11 {0} dB: the match is tuned
textos.Resuena, pero sin red en π adapta muy ma: It resonates, but without a π network it matches very poorly (−2.7 dB at 2.4 GHz and −4.6 dB at 868 MHz in simulation). Use the tunable version with π network. At 868 MHz each simulation takes more than 3 h.
textos.Resultado de la simulación (banda y gana: Simulation result (band and gain), if saved
textos.Rápida: para tantear (±3 %). Normal: dis: Fast: for a quick look (±3 %). Normal: design. Fine: final check (slower). Each simulation takes 1 to 15 min depending on size; tuning runs 2–5. If the design is saved, the result is saved with it.
textos.S11 plano y Z≈0: el modelo parece en cor: Flat S11 and Z≈0: the model looks short-circuited (gap not resolved by the mesh).
textos.SMA con balun impreso (un brazo en cada: SMA with printed balun (one arm on each face)
textos.SMA de canto (para probar y medir) o IPE: Edge-mount SMA (to test and measure) or IPEX/U.FL on top of the board (to fit inside a device).
textos.Saca el coaxial hacia atrás, por el lado: Take the coax out backwards, on the reflector side, close to the boom axis; a ferrite on the cable stops the braid radiating.
textos.Separación de la red al borde de los par: Distance from the network to the patch edge [mm]
textos.Separación entre dipolos > 0,9 λ0: apare: Dipole spacing > 0.9 λ0: grating lobes appear.
textos.Separación entre las dos pistas en la al: Spacing between the two tracks at the feed.
textos.Separación entre los conductores del ple: Spacing between the conductors of the folded dipole [mm]
textos.Separación entre parches 0,7–0,8 λ0: con: Patch spacing 0.7–0.8 λ0: above ~0.9 λ0 grating lobes appear.
textos.Separación típica entre directores 0,15–: Typical spacing between directors 0.15–0.3 λ0; directors 5–20 % shorter than the dipole.
textos.Serigrafía sin logo. Si compartes la pla: Silkscreen without logo. If you share the board, please mention Chirptenna. Thanks!
textos.Serigrafía: no cabe el grillo; va la pal: Silkscreen: the cricket does not fit; the word «Chirptenna» is used
textos.Simétrica con cruce (2 vías por bloque): Symmetric with crossing (2 vias per block)
textos.Sin cobre ajeno cerca de los elementos:: No foreign copper near the elements: the whole board is the antenna.
textos.Sin cortar resuena ~{0:.0f} MHz; cada ma: Uncut it resonates at ~{0:.0f} MHz; each mark shows, in MHz, the frequency left if you cut at it.
textos.Sin problema, el logo es opcional y la p: No problem, the logo is optional and the board is yours. If you share or sell it, it would help us a lot if you mentioned Chirptenna (in the description, with a link to the project…). That way more people can find it and improve it. Thanks!
textos.Sin terminar de validar: el centro de la: Not fully validated: the band centre jumps a lot with small changes and each iteration takes hours; the tuning does not iterate the frequency (one simulation and the gain is checked).
textos.Sobrelargo para recortar [% de frecuenci: Extra length to trim [% of frequency]
textos.Solo con «Bowtie de Sierpinski»: huecos: Only with «Sierpinski bowtie»: triangular gaps in the arm
textos.Son dos piezas: la placa de dipolos y el: There are two pieces: the dipole board and the reflector (the second board that is exported, or an aluminium sheet of the same size), joined at the corners with M3 nylon spacers as long as the separation. No metal spacers or screws.
textos.Sí: ventanas sin FR4 entre el borde y el: Yes: windows without FR4 between the edge and the centre
textos.Taladro por el que pasa el coaxial hasta: Hole the coax passes through to the centre. 1.7 mm for RG-316 / RG-174.
textos.Tamaño de las huellas de la red en π y d: Size of the π-network and bridge footprints: 0603 is easier to solder by hand.
textos.Tira de masa bajo la línea: ~λg/4 hace d: Ground strip under the line: ~λg/4 acts as a balun
textos.Tira en zigzag: reduce la altura a costa: Zigzag strip: reduces the height at the cost of bandwidth.
textos.Tira recta sobre la zona sin masa. Refer: Straight strip over the ground-free area. Reference for comparison.
textos.Todas las líneas de la red deben ir sobr: All network lines must lie over continuous ground and far (≥ 3h) from the patch edges.
textos.Todo lo validado hasta ahora es en simul: Everything validated so far is in simulation, with εr 4.5 for JLC's FR4: manufactured boards and the real εr with the coupon are still to be measured. Always measure before considering an antenna good.
textos.Todos iguales: el haz sale inclinado ~9°: All equal: the beam comes out ~9° tilted in the dipole plane (2×2)
textos.Tramo recto antes del zigzag, para separ: Straight section before the zigzag, to separate it from the ground plane.
textos.Tramos con puente (cada uno baja la frec: Sections with bridge (each one lowers the frequency)
textos.Tramos de λg/2 de dos tiras superpuestas: λg/2 sections of two overlapping strips (one on each face) that cross with vias at each junction: all radiate in phase. Omnidirectional, ~5–8 dBi depending on sections; long, narrow board. SMA at one end.
textos.Tramos sueltos al final del radiador. Ca: Loose sections at the end of the radiator. Each bridge you close lengthens the antenna and lowers the frequency one step.
textos.Transformador λ/4 en el boom (en revisió: λ/4 transformer on the boom (under review: it radiated backwards)
textos.Tres huellas de componente en la línea d: Three component footprints on the 50 Ω line (one in series, two to ground) to match the antenna with coils and capacitors after measuring it. From the factory: 0 Ω in series and the others empty.
textos.Triángulo de Sierpinski: multibanda, con: Sierpinski triangle: multiband, with bands in a ratio of ~2.
textos.Triángulo fractal de Sierpinski: mucho a: Sierpinski fractal triangle: very wide bandwidth, tolerates deviations.
textos.Una carcasa de plástico baja la frecuenc: A plastic case lowers the frequency by 2–5 %: measure and tune with the antenna inside.
textos.Una tira en zigzag: más baja que la rect: A zigzag strip: lower than the straight one, for short boards.
textos.Una tira recta sobre un plano de masa. L: A straight strip over a ground plane. The most predictable: the reference for comparison.
textos.Une los directores a la tira central: to: Joins the directors to the central strip: the whole antenna is grounded at DC (protects against static).
textos.Unidos por una tira central (cara inferi: Joined by a central strip (bottom face)
textos.Unidos: toda la antena queda a masa en c: Joined: the whole antenna is grounded at DC (protects against static)
textos.Validada en simulación (2,4 GHz y 868 MH: Validated in simulation (2.4 GHz and 868 MHz)
textos.Validada en simulación con elementos rec: Validated in simulation with straight elements
textos.Van en la cara de abajo, espejadas para: They go on the bottom face, mirrored so they read when you turn the board over, where they do not get in the way: over the ground or away from the antenna. If everything does not fit, the logo and the first line are kept and the last ones are dropped. Cut marks, the «vivo»/«malla» (live/braid) labels and component references are always added.
textos.Ventanas sin FR4 entre el cobre y el bor: Windows without FR4 between the copper and the edge: less weight. Not simulated: the frequency rises a little.
textos.Ya cubre la banda: {0:.1f} % estimado fr: Already covers the band: {0:.1f} % estimated versus {1:.1f} % needed (with margin).
textos.Ya hay un diseño llamado «{0}». ¿Sustitu: There is already a design called «{0}». Replace its geometry with the current one? Its simulations, measurements and notes are kept.
textos.Yagi impresa con directores: 6–7 dBi hac: Printed Yagi with directors: 6–7 dBi forwards, on a flat board.
textos.baja la iteración/orden, usa la masa λ/4: lower the iteration/order, use the λ/4 ground or a wider radiator (Sierpinski)
textos.ensancha los brazos de los dipolos o sep: widen the dipole arms or move the reflector farther away
textos.reactancia nula en los terminales (no ll: zero reactance at the terminals (does not reach −10 dB near the target)
textos.revisa: ¿está la carga puesta? Si sí, el: check: is the load connected? If so, the pigtail or the connectors have changed: recalibrate
textos.usa brazos rectos (iteración 0) o más an: use straight arms (iteration 0) or wider ones
textos.usa dipolo recto (iteración 0) o menos d: use a straight dipole (iteration 0) or fewer directors
textos.usa menos tramos o elementos (la banda s: use fewer sections or elements (the band narrows as they are added)
textos.usa un sustrato más grueso (o con menos: use a thicker substrate (or one with lower εr, such as RO4350B)
textos.{0} en {1} · barrido {2:g}–{3:g} MHz, {4: {0} on {1} · sweep {2:g}–{3:g} MHz, {4} points · device calibration: {5}
textos.{0}: cobre a {1:.2f} mm del borde (mínim: {0}: copper {1:.2f} mm from the edge (minimum {2} mm)
textos.{0}: hay cobre más estrecho que {1} mm (: {0}: there is copper narrower than {1} mm ({2:.3f} mm²)
textos.{0}: hay huecos más estrechos que {1} mm: {0}: there are gaps narrower than {1} mm ({2:.3f} mm²)
textos.{0}: resonancia medida {1:g} MHz ({2:+g}: {0}: measured resonance {1:g} MHz ({2:+g} % relative to {3:g} MHz), minimum S11 {4:g} dB; at the target {5:g} dB, Z = {6:g} {7:+g}j Ω
textos.|S11| con la carga: mediana {0:.1f} dB,: |S11| with the load: median {0:.1f} dB, worst {1:.1f} dB at {2:.0f} MHz ·
textos.«Ajustable» añade formas de corregir la: «Tunable» adds ways to correct the frequency and the match once manufactured: extra length with cut marks, sections with bridges and a π network. Recommended for the first batch.
textos.«Proporcionales»: al cambiar de frecuenc: «Proportional»: when changing frequency, tracks, gaps and other dimensions scale with the wavelength. It switches to «Manual» as soon as you set one by hand, so as not to overwrite it.
textos.¿Archivar «{0}»? Se mueve a la subcarpet: Archive «{0}»? It is moved to the _archivados subfolder; nothing is deleted.
Angle of the peaks of the Koch curve. 60° is the classic curve; a larger angle folds the track more.
textos.Ángulo del vértice del triángulo. 60° es: Apex angle of the triangle. 60° is the classic one; more aperture gives a wider triangle with more bandwidth.
textos.Ángulo total de cada triángulo (solo con: Total angle of each triangle (bowtie only)
textos.εr pendiente de medir con el cupón: εr still to be measured with the coupon
